senses.gloss: m.(b. h., דּוּר I) [circle, period, cmp. גִּיל] generation, contemporaries.
units: <cite ref="Arakhin 17a:5">Arakh. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ לפי פרנס</he> as the leader so the generation; a. v. fr.—<he>ד׳ הפלגה</he> the generation which witnessed the separation of races; <he>ד׳ המבול</he> which perished in the flood; <he>ד׳ המדבר</he> which perished in the desert, &c.

Snh. X, 3 (107ᵇ, sq.); a. fr.—Pl. דּוֹרוֹת. Ib. 99ᵃ; a. fr.—לַדּוֹרוֹת for all time to come; permanent, opp. לשעה, הוראת שעה a temporary ordinance. Ib. 16ᵇ (ref. to Num. VII, 1) אותם במשיחה ולא לד׳ וכ׳ only they were installed with ointment, but not as a precedent for future installations; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Menachot 19b:5">Men. 19ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>ד׳ משעה לא ילפינן</he> a permanent law cannot be derived from a special temporary legislation.—<he>פסח ד׳</he> annual Passover celebration, opp. to <he>פסח מצרים</he> the one observed in Epypt.
